blind.second_guess: stair landing or low wooden stool
blind.description: A square stylized wooden platform or low landing stage. It features a flat slatted deck made of five parallel wooden planks bordered by rectangular side beams. At the four corners stand square posts, each capped with a domed copper/bronze-trimmed finial and reinforced at the bottom with matching metal brackets or footing caps with visible rivet details. Curved wooden support brackets brace the connection between the legs and the underside of the deck framing. All surfaces are continuous, clean, and hand-painted in warm brown wood and brass/bronze metal tones.
blind.from_above: A square deck surface of five vertical planks bordered at top and bottom by horizontal framing beams, with four square corner post caps featuring rounded pyramidal tops.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.45 times the height of the figure (around 2.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 to 3 ft wide on each side.
